title: Concrete structural section modules
statement: Let A and C be commutative rings, h:Y → Spec A and s:E → Spec C scheme morphisms, and f ∈ A. Define the A_f-module with underlying additive group Γ(Y,h⁻¹D(f)) by composing the canonical localization isomorphism A_f → Γ(Spec A,D(f)) with h.app D(f). Define the C-module with underlying additive group Γ(E,top) by its structural section map. These constructions use no existence witnesses. Restricting the first action to A gives multiplication by the structural section of a for every a ∈ A.

proof.text: Compose the canonical localization-to-basic-open section isomorphism with h.app D(f) and use Module.compHom. Use Module.compHom for completed global sections. The canonical localization isomorphism commutes with algebraMap; naturality of h.app identifies its restriction to A with the structural section map. This proves chartSectionModule_smul.
